# Where AI might plug in

## A neural network as a component?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="44%"}
- Universal differential equations and physics-informed neural networks
  pair a network with a mechanistic model
- Philipps et al.: the network "consistently hindered parameter
  identifiability"
- No neural network code in any EpiAware package. Maybe nothing doing
  there at the moment
- Reinforcement learning and bandits on individual-based simulators.
  Could a composable component be the environment?

::: {.attribution}
Rackauckas et al. (2020),
[arXiv:2001.04385](https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.04385) ·
Millevoi, Pasetto and Ferronato (2024), PLoS Computational Biology,
[PMC11407682](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11407682/) ·
Philipps, Schmid and Hasenauer (2025), npj Systems Biology and
Applications,
[PMC12398592](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12398592/) ·
Grep of the EpiAware organisation for Lux and Flux, 2026-09-11
:::

## Agents building and checking the parts

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="56%"}
- [BVDOutbreakSize][bvd]. Bundibugyo virus disease, DRC. McCabe et al.
  replicated the day after their report
- 333 of 425 pull requests, the unit of change on GitHub, came from my
  bot account
- Agents read the French PDF situation reports. Two blind reads per
  vintage of the onset chart
- SitRep 087 changed the y axis steps from 20 to 25. Caught only by the
  reporting-triangle invariant
- Could agents build and check the simulators you learn against?

::: {.attribution}
[github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize][bvd], `README.md` and
`data/README.md:77-111`, SitReps 104 to 114 · McCabe et al. report of
18 May 2026, repository created 19 May · Pull request count from the
GitHub API, 2026-09-11
